description: A quantiser that rounds a voltage down to one of a number of even steps

params.text: Sets how many steps the range of 0V to 10V is cut into, 1 to 32; the number is shown on the display
An attenuverter, -10 to +10, setting how far the voltage at the steps input changes the number of steps

inputs.text: Changes the number of steps away from the knob setting, by as much as the trimmer allows

outputs.text: The input voltage rounded down to the nearest step
